name: privacymagic
description: a browser extension that protects your privacy online

scripts.build: npm run build:math && rm -rf dist && npx tsx tools/filter-list-processor.ts && NODE_ENV=production npm run copy && NODE_ENV=production node esbuild.config.js && web-ext build --source-dir dist --overwrite-dest --artifacts-dir artifacts --filename privacymagic.zip
scripts.build:firefox: npm run build:math && rm -rf dist-firefox && EXTENSION_TARGET=firefox npx tsx tools/filter-list-processor.ts && NODE_ENV=production EXTENSION_TARGET=firefox npm run copy:firefox && NODE_ENV=production EXTENSION_TARGET=firefox node esbuild.config.js && web-ext build --source-dir dist-firefox --overwrite-dest --artifacts-dir artifacts --filename privacymagic-firefox.zip
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run copy:watch" "NODE_ENV=development node esbuild.config.js watch" "web-ext run -t chromium --source-dir dist --ignore-files _metadata _metadata/** privacymagic/**"
scripts.dev:edge: concurrently "npm run copy:watch" "NODE_ENV=development node esbuild.config.js watch" "web-ext run -t chromium --chromium-binary \"/Applications/Microsoft Edge.app/Contents/MacOS/Microsoft Edge\" --source-dir dist --ignore-files _metadata _metadata/** privacymagic/**"
scripts.dev:opera: concurrently "npm run copy:watch" "NODE_ENV=development node esbuild.config.js watch" "web-ext run -t chromium --chromium-binary \"/Applications/Opera.app/Contents/MacOS/Opera\" --source-dir dist --ignore-files _metadata _metadata/** privacymagic/**"
scripts.dev:firefox: concurrently "npm run copy:firefox:watch" "NODE_ENV=development EXTENSION_TARGET=firefox node esbuild.config.js watch" "web-ext run -t firefox-desktop --source-dir dist-firefox --ignore-files _metadata _metadata/** privacymagic/**"

author: Arthur Edelstein
